s.en: A grey greatcoat. A grey mask.

s.jp: 仮面の奥の目が、細く笑っている。
s.en: Behind the mask, his eyes narrowed in a smile.

s.jp: 「時晶の停止に、巻き戻しで応じたか」
s.en: "She answered the crystal's stopping with a rewind, did she."

s.jp: 「十年探したのだ。今度こそ、逃がすわけにはいかぬ」
s.en: "Ten years I have searched. This time, I cannot let her slip away."

s.en: In the man's hand, a silver pocket watch was quietly ticking.

s.en: On its lid was engraved the very same crest as on Sera's.

s.en: The only difference was that its hands were turning — the right way round.
